paths.description: Homepage and age-verification entry; represents global navigation, discovery grid, preferences, security, performance and accessibility.
Teen category listing; represents category/list template. Other categories were not repeated because they share this template.
Search results for a representative query; exercises the primary find-content journey.
Brazzers channel page; represents channel and creator/entity listing templates.
Representative video detail page; checks detail metadata and pre-verification media state. Playback was not attempted because the site requires regulated age verification.
Unknown URL redirected to the first-party 404 page; exercises recovery from a bad route.
German locale homepage; represents the only advertised non-default locale.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not respond to the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The preference probe confirmed prefers-color-scheme: dark, but the page declares color-scheme: normal and the light and dark captures are visually identical; body remains rgb(0,0,0).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide light/dark surface tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Some foreground/background combinations fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.75 and its color-contrast audit found one failing element.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust the failing foreground or surface token to meet WCAG contrast and verify in high-contrast/forced-color modes.

findings.summary: Dismissible overlays use custom Bootstrap-style divs rather than native dialog/popover semantics.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found #favoriteModal as a div role=dialog with nested div role=document, data-backdrop=static and a close button with no accessible name.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> or popover with declarative controls, light dismiss where safe, focus management, and a named close button.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on key controls.
findings.evidence: The focus probe focused the visible logo link and computed outline was none (0px) with no box shadow; several icon buttons also lack names.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible ring with adequate contrast to every interactive control.

findings.summary: Mobile Largest Contentful Paint is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 4.4s (score 0.40), despite the unthrottled trace reporting 663ms; the mobile lab result exceeds the 2.5s good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP image, reduce competing third-party/script work, and validate under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Resource delivery has a long dependency chain and avoidable weight.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 49 requests and 1,339,517 transferred bytes; Lighthouse reported an 879ms longest dependency chain. Parser-inserted jQuery and all.min.js lack async/defer, although they are placed near the end of body.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable dependencies, self-host or defer non-critical code, and preserve preload only for genuinely critical assets.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 204 KiB unused JavaScript: 71 KiB gtag, 63 KiB GTM, 53 KiB Yandex and 21 KiB first-party JS; it also estimated 11 KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics loaders, conditionally load features, and split first-party bundles/styles by template.

findings.summary: Dozens of icon buttons have no accessible name.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 52 buttons without accessible names; the DOM probe independently counted 55 unlabeled buttons, including search, account, menu, favorite and close controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon-only button a concise aria-label or visually hidden text and preserve visible tooltip text where useful.

findings.summary: The page lacks a main landmark and consistent visible focus structure.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main; the focus probe found no visible outline, weakening keyboard orientation despite otherwise coherent h1/h2 ordering.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main>, add a skip link, and provide persistent :focus-visible styling with logical tab order.

findings.summary: Many mobile touch targets are too small or tightly spaced.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 24 target-size failures; the 360px probe measured top icon controls at 20x20, Get started at 32px high, pills at 34px high and several links at 18px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 44x44 CSS pixel hit areas or sufficient spacing without shrinking the visible icon.

findings.summary: Some images omit intrinsic dimensions and alt text.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 5 images without dimensions and 2 without alt text among 100 images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height or aspect-ratio and appropriate alt text (empty for decorative flags, descriptive where meaningful).

findings.summary: Browser platform hygiene is weakened by bfcache and DevTools issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices scored 0.77, found an Inspector issue, and reported five reasons preventing back/forward cache restoration.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the reported Inspector issue and bfcache blockers, then retest back/forward navigation.

findings.summary: Several crawler-visible links have non-descriptive text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO found four links without descriptive text, while raw HTML coverage was otherwise 100%.
findings.suggestedFix: Give linked images and generic links descriptive accessible/link text that communicates their destination.

findings.summary: Pages omit Open Graph/social preview metadata.
findings.evidence: Home and detail probes found no og:* metadata. The detail page does provide useful VideoObject JSON-LD, title, description and canonical URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url and video metadata per template.

findings.summary: Transport and browser security policies are incomplete, and HSTS is effectively disabled.
findings.evidence: Headers show no CSP, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. Strict-Transport-Security is sent with max-age=0, which removes HSTS protection rather than enabling it.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP, a non-zero long-lived HSTS policy after validation, strict referrer policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Session and analytics cookies lack basic protections.
findings.evidence: Cookie audit found PHPSESSID, kt_tcookie, kt_is_visited and Google Analytics cookies without Secure; PHPSESSID also lacks HttpOnly, and several cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on session/auth cookies, choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential, and shorten analytics retention.

findings.summary: Tracking begins before age verification or any visible consent choice.
findings.evidence: On initial load the tracker probe contacted five third-party origins including Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and Yandex; HAR attributed about 379 KiB to GTM/Yandex scripts and cookies included 365-400 day identifiers.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not initialize non-essential analytics before consent; minimize vendors and retention, and document the data flow clearly.

findings.summary: The German locale leaves the age-verification call to action in English.
findings.evidence: The German page correctly sets lang=de and translates navigation/dates, but its prominent legal age banner still reads “Verify your age…”, “It’s fast…” and “Get started” in English.
findings.suggestedFix: Localize all legal, trust and action copy as one atomic message and include it in translation completeness checks.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes hundreds of kilobytes.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 420 KiB image savings. The image probe found 15 oversized images, 59 without srcset and all 100 reported img URLs in legacy JPEG/PNG formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and correctly sized responsive srcsets, especially for 48px avatars and logos.

findings.summary: Analytics and background tracking consume a disproportionate share of initial work.
findings.evidence: GTM and Yandex scripts transfer about 379 KiB before interaction; Yandex performs multiple cookie-sync redirects and Lighthouse identifies most analytics code as unused on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics, gate remaining vendors on consent and visibility, and batch or deprioritize non-essential telemetry.

findings.summary: The age banner’s privacy reassurance conflicts with observed tracking.
findings.evidence: The banner says “we don’t store personal data,” yet the initial page sets persistent Google/Yandex identifiers and sends analytics requests before the visitor starts age verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the absolute claim with accurate, specific disclosure and prevent non-essential tracking until consent.
